exposure: Race/ethnicity (Non-Hispanic Black, White, Hispanic, Asian/Pacific Islander)
cohort: 604,287 births to women aged 13 to 23 years
finding: Young maternal age is protective against cesarean delivery in all racial/ethnic groups, with the lowest risk observed in adolescents compared to young adults.
mod_finding: Young maternal age is associated with lower risk of cesarean delivery across all racial and ethnic groups.
